home.heroSubtitle: Set budgets, track expenses automatically across intelligent categories, and split group bills effortlessly with friends and colleagues. Secure, private, and lightning fast.
home.featuresSubtitle: Built with robust security standards and intuitive workflows to keep your personal and group finances perfectly balanced.
home.feature1Desc: Allocate monthly spending limits by category, track your pace in real-time, and get notified before you exceed your target thresholds.
home.feature2Desc: Split dinners, group trips, and shared household bills among friends using equal splits, percentages, or custom exact amounts instantly.
home.feature3Desc: Your financial data is protected with encrypted sessions, secure database indexing, and strict user data isolation guarantees.
